title: Skill Marketplace Dependency Resolver
hints: Compare versions as integer tuples. As strings, '1.10.0' sorts below '1.9.2'.
Caret is about the leftmost non-zero part: ^1.2.3 allows <2.0.0, ^0.2.3 allows <0.3.0, ^0.0.3 allows only 0.0.3. Tilde always allows patch changes only.
Recursive search: pick the alphabetically first undecided package, try its allowed versions highest first, add that version's deps, and recurse. Undo on failure by passing copies.
When a new dep contradicts a package you already chose, that candidate fails right there. Remember only the first dead end for the explanation.
